### Stay with the Truth
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-may-8-2024.html
Passage: Job 21:27-30
Points:
- Facing false accusations and schemes is an anguishing burden to bear.
- Calmly listen to what critics say while keeping their character in mind.
- Resist reacting impulsively in the flesh or seeking retaliation.
- Answer charges with verifiable facts and steadfast honesty.
- Rely on personal integrity and trust God for ultimate vindication.

### Devotional: Job 21
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-4-luke-7-job-21-1-corinthians-8/
Passage: Job 21:7
Points:
- Job raises the troubling reality that wicked people often enjoy peace, wealth, and long lives.
- Simple tit-for-tat formulas fail to explain the complex realities of human suffering.
- Defending God does not require denying observable facts or distorting the truth.
- Measured strictly by earthly circumstances, this world often appears grossly unjust.
- Full and final justice is accomplished after death through the God who endured the cross.
